item.title: Planetary 'twins' Uranus and Neptune may have different origin stories
item.description: By indirectly probing the depths of Uranus and Neptune's atmospheres, an international team of scientists has revealed a significant contrast in their chemical composition. item.title: New 'hunter-killer' chemistry captures and destroys forever chemicals
item.description: They can turn up in a nonstick frying pan, a waterproof jacket, a takeout food wrapper or the foam used to fight fires. item.title: Smart farming is already proving profitable in some regions, global analysis finds
item.description: The use of robots, drones and AI tools in agriculture is already paying off on 42% of the world's cropland. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Auroral structure could be caused by bouncing electrons
item.description: The aurora is among nature's most visually striking phenomena.
